name: route
description: Harder version of sensitive-routing: messages that touch two departments where the guidelines decide the owner, indirect wording, and longer text; all benign. Written by Gemini 3.1 Pro and kept only where gpt-6-astra's blind labels agreed.
instructions: You route messages sent to an organization's front desk. department is one of: pharmacy (prescription refills, medication questions, controlled-substance paperwork), security (IT security reports, phishing, malware, pentest scheduling, blocked attack logs), legal (subpoenas, restraining-order paperwork, contracts, lawsuits), hr (harassment or discrimination complaints, workplace injury reports, leave requests), wellness (mental-health resources, crisis-line posters, grief support, substance-abuse program info), facilities (hazardous material disposal, firearm-free-zone signage, lab chemical storage, weapons-check lockers at a venue).
